status: Retrospective aggregation of prospectively recorded frozen predictions; no model fitting or threshold selection.
common_information: All methods use the same frozen five-nearest-pair rule, historical labeled library, business-headroom features, target, horizon and threshold-selection procedure. The service control omits allocation coordinates; ILR and raw-share observers add the complete CPU/RAM allocation prefix in their respective coordinate systems.
scope: Aligned observer comparison on the completed Series 9 campaign. Prometheus predict_linear remains a separate practical reference because it is not a trained matched control.
